title: terminalia oblongata subsp. volucris
intro: Terminalia oblongata subsp. volucris, commonly known as  'Buddha's Hand', is a subspecies of the Terminalia oblongata plant, which is a type of tree native to Australia and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its unique ability to stimulate the body's natural healing processes, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Terminalia oblongata subsp. volucris include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are believed to help in managing conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
